EnchantmentProtectionDef.description:
Protection points in vanilla's shared pool against the hits of one damage type tag (its
``minecraft:damage_protection`` effect, as Projectile Protection's).

against.description: The damage type tag of the hits it lowers, without '#', e.g. realmforge:is_magic (every magic school and vanilla's magic) or minecraft:is_projectile.
against.title: Against

points_per_level.description: Protection points each level gives, e.g. 0.5; a point lowers a hit by 4 %, and all protection points on the armor together stop at 20 (80 %).
points_per_level.title: Points Per Level

EnchantmentProtectionDef.title: EnchantmentProtectionDef

LocalizedText.description: A player-facing text, keyed by locale. Realmforge ships English only, so en_us is the one locale.
LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText

description: An enchantment: its name and tooltip line, where and how it is enchanted, and what it does.

anvil_cost.description: Its anvil price per level (half from a book).
anvil_cost.title: Anvil Cost

description.description: Its tooltip line under the name (Apothic Enchanting's inline descriptions, Enchantment Descriptions' key): which hits it lowers.

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

max_cost.description: The highest enchanting power that gives each level.

max_level.description: The highest level with Apothic Enchanting, e.g. 8 (its enchantment_info data map).
max_level.title: Max Level

min_cost.description: The lowest enchanting power that gives each level.

name.description: Its name, as the tooltip and the enchanting table show it.

slots.description: Where the item must be for it to work, e.g. [armor].
slots.title: Slots

supported_items.description: The item tag it can go on, without '#', e.g. minecraft:enchantable/armor.
supported_items.title: Supported Items

tags.description: Vanilla's enchantment tags it joins, e.g. minecraft:non_treasure: the enchanting table, random loot, mobs' and traders' gear, as the other protections.

items.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

tags.title: Tags

vanilla_max_level.description: Vanilla's highest level, which counts where Apothic Enchanting does not (IV).
vanilla_max_level.title: Vanilla Max Level

weight.description: How often the table and loot pick it (Projectile Protection 5).
weight.title: Weight
